+# Action inputs
+
+The inputs of each GitHub Action in this repository, read from its `action.yml`.
+
+## px1 PR review artifact
+
+`action.yml`
+
+Understand the code your agent wrote before you merge it, with a static report for human review.
+
+| Input | Required | Default | Description |
+| --- | --- | --- | --- |
+| `base` | yes |  | Full base commit SHA. |
+| `head` | yes |  | Full pull-request head commit SHA. |
+| `root` | no | `${{ github.workspace }}` | Repository checkout to inspect. |
+| `out` | no | `.px1-review` | Directory where the static report is written. |
+| `verification-file` | no |  | Optional exact-revision verification JSON file. |
+| `explanations-file` | no |  | Optional commit-pinned explanation JSON file. |
+| `explanation-model` | no |  | Optional OpenAI model used to generate explanations. Sends bounded, non-excluded diff content to the configured endpoint and requires OPENAI_API_KEY in the caller environment. |
+| `explanation-endpoint` | no | `https://api.openai.com/v1/responses` | Responses API endpoint used when explanation-model is set. |
+| `explanation-exclude-globs` | no |  | Optional newline-separated repository globs omitted from AI input. Exclusion is not redaction. |
+| `privacy-check` | no | `true` | Fail when the generated report contains high-confidence secret signatures or sensitive paths. This check is not redaction or access control. |
+
+## px1 agentic PR review
+
+`agentic-action/action.yml`
+
+An AI reviewer that investigates a pull request with read-only tools and comments only on findings it verified.
+
+| Input | Required | Default | Description |
+| --- | --- | --- | --- |
+| `model` | yes |  | OpenAI model, for example gpt-6-luna. |
+| `price-input` | yes |  | Model input price in USD per million tokens. The cost cap is only as accurate as the prices you give. |
+| `price-output` | yes |  | Model output price in USD per million tokens. |
+| `price-cached-input` | no |  | Cached input price in USD per million tokens (default same as input). |
+| `max-cost` | no | `0.50` | Hard cost cap in USD per run. |
+| `exclude-globs` | no |  | Optional newline-separated globs never shown to the model. Exclusion is not redaction. |
+| `post` | no | `true` | Post findings to the pull request (true) or only write them to the job summary (false). |
+
+## px1 review artifact history
+
+`history/action.yml`
+
+Restore or publish immutable px1 reports on a generated-only branch.
+
+| Input | Required | Default | Description |
+| --- | --- | --- | --- |
+| `mode` | yes |  | Either restore or publish. |
+| `site` | no | `site` | Directory containing reviews/\<head-sha>/index.html, review.json, and checksums.sha256. |
+| `branch` | no | `px1-review-reports` | Generated-only branch used to retain old report links. |

+<!-- Generated by `px1 docs gen` from the source files in `covers`. Do not edit. -->
+
+# Command-line reference
+
+Every `px1` subcommand and its flags, read from the source.
+
+- [`px1 agentic-review`](#px1-agentic-review)
+- [`px1 docs`](#px1-docs)
+- [`px1 eval-compare`](#px1-eval-compare)
+- [`px1 eval-run`](#px1-eval-run)
+- [`px1 export-review`](#px1-export-review)
+- [`px1 feedback-collect`](#px1-feedback-collect)
+- [`px1 generate-explanations`](#px1-generate-explanations)
+- [`px1 mcp`](#px1-mcp)
+- [`px1 post-github`](#px1-post-github)
+- [`px1 privacy-check`](#px1-privacy-check)
+- [`px1 summary-comment`](#px1-summary-comment)
+- [`px1 validate-config`](#px1-validate-config)
+- [`px1 validate-rules`](#px1-validate-rules)
+
+## px1 agentic-review
+
+Reviews two commits of a local clone with the agentic pipeline and writes a commit-pinned report. It sends repository content to the model provider, so it previews what would be sent and requires --yes.
+
+| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
+| --- | --- | --- | --- |
+| `--base` | string |  | base commit or ref (required) |
+| `--head` | string | `HEAD` | head commit or ref |
+| `--root` | string | `.` | repository root (a local clone) |
+| `--out` | string | `px1-agentic` | output directory |
+| `--model` | string |  | OpenAI model (required) |
+| `--endpoint` | string | `https://api.openai.com/v1/responses` | Responses API endpoint |
+| `--price-input` | number | `0` | model input price in USD per million tokens (required) |
+| `--price-output` | number | `0` | model output price in USD per million tokens (required) |
+| `--price-cached-input` | number | `0` | cached input price in USD per million tokens (default: same as input) |
+| `--tier` | string | `plus` | agentic tier: plus or apex |
+| `--max-cost` | number | `1.00` | hard cost cap in USD; the review stops when it could be crossed |
+| `--max-minutes` | integer | `0` | wall-time limit in minutes (default: the tier's) |
+| `--max-output-tokens` | integer | `4000` | output-token limit per model call; reasoning models need room for their reasoning |
+| `--max-files` | integer | `40` | most changed files sent to the model; a larger change is reviewed in part, risky files first (0 = no limit) |
+| `--max-diff-bytes` | integer | `120000` | most diff bytes sent to the model (0 = no limit) |
+| `--concurrency` | integer | `3` | sub-agents running at once |
+| `--exclude-glob` | value |  | repository-relative glob never shown to the model (repeatable) |
+| `--title` | string |  | pull request title (default: the head commit subject) |
+| `--body` | string |  | pull request description |
+| `--yes` | boolean |  | send repository content to the model provider |
+| `--dry-run` | boolean |  | show what would be sent and what it could cost; send nothing |
+| `--transcripts` | boolean | `true` | save raw prompts and replies under \<out>/private for debugging |
+
+## px1 docs
+
+Maintains the documentation under docs/. "px1 docs gen" writes the reference pages, the manifest and the index from the code and the pages; "px1 docs check" fails when they are out of date, a link is broken, or code has no page. It reads files only.
+
+| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
+| --- | --- | --- | --- |
+| `--root` | string | `.` | repository root |
+
+## px1 eval-compare
+
+Scores two eval-run result files against the same cases and says whether the difference is larger than run-to-run noise. It sends nothing anywhere: it reads files only.
+
+| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
+| --- | --- | --- | --- |
+| `--cases` | string |  | the repeat dataset both runs used (required) |
+| `--before` | string |  | results.json from the earlier eval-run (required) |
+| `--after` | string |  | results.json from the later eval-run (required) |
+| `--line-slack` | integer | `3` | lines a finding may be from a label and still match |
+| `--require-class` | boolean |  | also require the finding's type to equal the label's bug_class |
+| `--out` | string |  | optional file to write the comparison to |
+
+## px1 eval-run
+
+Reviews every case in a repeat dataset several times with the agentic reviewer and scores the results. It goes through runAgenticReview for each run, so consent, the privacy policy and the per-review cost cap are exactly those of a normal review, and adds a cap on the total spend.
+
+| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
+| --- | --- | --- | --- |
+| `--cases` | string |  | repeat dataset JSON (required) |
+| `--root` | string | `.` | local clone holding every case's commits |
+| `--out` | string | `px1-eval` | output directory |
+| `--model` | string |  | OpenAI model (required) |
+| `--endpoint` | string | `https://api.openai.com/v1/responses` | Responses API endpoint |
+| `--price-input` | number | `0` | input price, USD per million tokens (required) |
+| `--price-output` | number | `0` | output price, USD per million tokens (required) |
+| `--price-cached-input` | number | `0` | cached input price (default: same as input) |
+| `--tier` | string | `plus` | agentic tier: plus or apex |
+| `--max-cost` | number | `0.50` | hard cap per review, USD |
+| `--max-total-cost` | number | `5.00` | hard cap for the whole evaluation, USD |
+| `--runs` | integer | `3` | reviews per case; at least 3 to see run-to-run variance |
+| `--line-slack` | integer | `3` | lines a finding may be from a label and still match |
+| `--require-class` | boolean |  | also require the finding's type to equal the label's bug_class |
+| `--max-minutes` | integer | `0` | wall-time limit per review in minutes (default: the tier's) |
+| `--max-output-tokens` | integer | `4000` | output-token limit per model call |
+| `--concurrency` | integer | `3` | sub-agents running at once |
+| `--max-files` | integer | `40` | most changed files sent per review |
+| `--max-diff-bytes` | integer | `120000` | most diff bytes sent per review |
+| `--exclude-glob` | value |  | repository-relative glob never shown to the model (repeatable) |
+| `--yes` | boolean |  | send repository content to the model provider |
+| `--dry-run` | boolean |  | list the cases; send nothing |
+| `--resume` | boolean |  | skip reviews already in \<out>/results.json |
+
+## px1 export-review
+
+Builds the static review report for two commits of a local clone: an HTML page and review.json. It runs git only and sends nothing anywhere.
+
+| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
+| --- | --- | --- | --- |
+| `--base` | string |  | base commit or ref (required) |
+| `--head` | string | `HEAD` | head commit or ref |
+| `--root` | string | `.` | repository root |
+| `--out` | string | `.px1-review` | directory to write the static report |
+| `--snapshot-out` | string |  | optional path to write the versioned review snapshot JSON |
+| `--verification-file` | string |  | optional verification JSON file to validate for the head commit |
+| `--explanations-file` | string |  | optional AI explanation JSON file to validate for the head commit |
+| `--findings-file` | string |  | optional hosted AI findings JSON file to validate for the head commit |
+| `--trace-file` | string |  | optional agentic review trace JSON file to validate for the head commit |
+
+## px1 feedback-collect
+
+Counts the thumbs-up, thumbs-down and replies people left on px1's inline review comments in one repository. It reads from the GitHub API with GITHUB_TOKEN and writes nothing there.
+
+| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
+| --- | --- | --- | --- |
+| `--repo` | string | computed: `os.Getenv("GITHUB_REPOSITORY")` | owner/name (default: $GITHUB_REPOSITORY) |
+| `--days` | integer | `30` | only comments from the last N days |
+| `--api-url` | string | computed: `envOr("GITHUB_API_URL", "https://api.github.com")` | GitHub API base URL |
+| `--out` | string |  | optional file for the JSON result |
+
+## px1 generate-explanations
+
+Asks a model to explain the changed blocks between two commits and writes commit-pinned explanation JSON for export-review. It sends bounded, non-excluded diff content to the endpoint and needs OPENAI_API_KEY.
+
+| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
+| --- | --- | --- | --- |
+| `--base` | string |  | base commit or ref (required) |
+| `--head` | string | `HEAD` | head commit or ref |
+| `--root` | string | `.` | repository root |
+| `--out` | string | `px1-explanations.json` | explanation JSON output path |
+| `--model` | string |  | OpenAI model (required) |
+| `--endpoint` | string | `https://api.openai.com/v1/responses` | Responses API endpoint |
+| `--exclude-glob` | value |  | repository-relative glob excluded from model input (repeatable) |
+
+## px1 mcp
+
+Serves px1's hosted MCP tools to a local agent over stdio. The CLI has no hosted data of its own: it lists the tools the API key may use on the hosted server and forwards each call there.
+
+| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
+| --- | --- | --- | --- |
+| `--url` | string | `https://mcp.px1.dev/mcp` | hosted px1 MCP endpoint |
+
+## px1 post-github
+
+Publishes findings.json to a pull request: one sticky summary comment that is updated on every push, plus inline comments for findings that sit on lines the pull request changed. The token comes only from GITHUB_TOKEN.
+
+| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
+| --- | --- | --- | --- |
+| `--findings` | string |  | findings.json written by agentic-review (required) |
+| `--repo` | string | computed: `os.Getenv("GITHUB_REPOSITORY")` | owner/name (default: $GITHUB_REPOSITORY) |
+| `--pr` | integer | `0` | pull request number (required) |
+| `--head` | string |  | full head commit SHA the review was run on (default: the findings revision) |
+| `--scope` | string |  | scope.json written by agentic-review; states when only part of a large change was reviewed |
+| `--footer` | string |  | one line appended to the summary, such as the run cost |
+| `--api-url` | string | computed: `envOr("GITHUB_API_URL", "https://api.github.com")` | GitHub API base URL |
+| `--dry-run` | boolean |  | print what would be posted; call nothing |
+
+## px1 privacy-check
+
+Scans a generated review.json for high-confidence secret signatures and sensitive paths and fails when it finds any. It is a check before publishing, not redaction or access control.
+
+| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
+| --- | --- | --- | --- |
+| `--review-file` | string |  | path to generated review.json (required) |
+
+## px1 summary-comment
+
+Renders the sticky pull-request summary comment for a static review from review.json and the report's URL. It prints Markdown and posts nothing.
+
+| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
+| --- | --- | --- | --- |
+| `--review-file` | string |  | path to review.json (required) |
+| `--artifact-url` | string |  | commit-pinned report URL (required) |
+| `--out` | string |  | optional file to write instead of stdout |
+
+## px1 validate-config
+
+Resolves the px1 configuration that applies to one path, merging the config files from the repository root down to that path, and prints the result as JSON. It fails when a config file is invalid.
+
+| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
+| --- | --- | --- | --- |
+| `--root` | string | `.` | repository root |
+| `--path` | string | `README.md` | repository-relative path to resolve |
+
+## px1 validate-rules
+
+Checks a team rules JSON file and reports its errors and warnings.
+
+| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
+| --- | --- | --- | --- |
+| `--file` | string | `.px1/rules.json` | rules JSON file |
+| `--json` | boolean |  | write a machine-readable validation summary |

explanations.title: Rename the documentation generator
explanations.summary: The docs subcommand is now `px1 docs gen`; the former `manifest` command is no longer accepted. `gen` writes generated documentation, while `check` remains the validation command.

explanations.title: Check generated reference content
explanations.summary: `px1 docs check` now compares generated reference content as well as the manifest and index. Errors while deriving reference content—such as invalid source or missing generated-region markers—are returned instead of being skipped.

explanations.title: Generate reference documentation
explanations.summary: Generation now writes reference content before updating the manifest and index. This makes the generated reference pages and marked table regions part of the normal documentation-generation workflow.

explanations.title: Keep schema and tool tables in sync
explanations.summary: The finding-fields and agent-tool tables are now generated from the JSON schema and `Toolbox.Specs`, respectively, and replace only the text inside their markers. A page without the expected markers causes generation and checking to fail.

explanations.title: Derive action inputs from action files
explanations.summary: Action inputs are now discovered from `action.yml` files and used to generate the action reference. The parser rejects unsupported input YAML shapes, so changes such as multiline input values can make documentation generation fail rather than produce an incomplete table.

explanations.title: Build CLI reference from source
explanations.summary: The CLI reference is derived by parsing command dispatch, run-function comments, and flag definitions from Go source; the generator reads source files rather than running the commands. The new summary test ensures every discovered command has a description.
